Two high-risk user requirements are not currently verified: **URS-EBR-009** and **URS-INC-004**.

**1. URS-EBR-009** (“Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs”, risk FRA-042, HIGH, severity 9)
- No test case verifies this requirement. The only trace link to it is from CS-EBR-03 (the MOI range check configuration, hard stop), and nothing verifies CS-EBR-03.
- The nearest test, TC-OQ-EBR-04 (vector volume calculation), verifies URS-EBR-007 and CS-EBR-02 only. TC-OQ-EBR-06 verifies URS-EBR-010, not 009. No executed test checks the MOI range rejection.
- This matters now: change request CC-26-022 (MAJOR, in impact assessment) proposes raising the transduction target MOI to 8.0 TU/cell, which would fall outside the 4.0–6.0 range this requirement enforces.

**2. URS-INC-004** (“A door-open alarm shall activate when the door is open for more than 60 s”, risk FRA-004, HIGH, severity 9)
- The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its INC-03 execution (TX-0023) FAILED: the alarm activated at 142 s against a limit of 60 s. The other three incubators passed (TX-0021, TX-0022, TX-0024).
- The requirement has not been demonstrated on INC-03. The re-test is still outstanding: CC-26-019 (door switch replacement) is approved but not implemented, and it requires re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03. CAPA-26-012, which calls for that replacement and re-test, is still OPEN past its 2026-03-31 due date.
- OQ-INC-01 was approved with an exception under DEV-26-011, which was closed as a minor test incident on 2026-02-24. Closing the deviation does not replace the missing passing execution.

**Checked and treated as verified:** the other HIGH-risk URS items have passing executions, either directly or through a derived CS/FS spec that traces to them. One caveat: TX-0070 for URS-EMS-014 predates CC-26-011 (paging provider change, implemented 2026-03-16). That change was assessed as needing no re-test, so I did not count it as unverified, but a reviewer may want to confirm that assessment.

WITH hi AS (

  WHERE r.risk_class='HIGH' AND r.ri_id LIKE 'FRA%')

LEFT JOIN pd.val_test_case tc ON tc.tc_id=tl.src_id
LEFT JOIN pd.val_test_exec e ON e.tc_id=tl.src_id
LEFT JOIN pd.val_protocol p ON p.protocol_id=tc.protocol_id
ORDER BY h.urs, tl.src_id, e.exec_id;

Two high-risk user requirements are not currently verified: **URS-EBR-009** and **URS-INC-004**.

**1. URS-EBR-009** (“Target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell shall be rejected for GMP runs”, risk FRA-042, HIGH, severity 9)
- No test case verifies this requirement. The only trace link to it is from CS-EBR-03 (the MOI range check configuration, hard stop), and nothing verifies CS-EBR-03.
- The nearest test, TC-OQ-EBR-04 (vector volume calculation), verifies URS-EBR-007 and CS-EBR-02 only. TC-OQ-EBR-06 verifies URS-EBR-010, not 009. No executed test checks the MOI range rejection.
- This matters now: change request CC-26-022 (MAJOR, in impact assessment) proposes raising the transduction target MOI to 8.0 TU/cell, which would fall outside the 4.0–6.0 range this requirement enforces.

**2. URS-INC-004** (“A door-open alarm shall activate when the door is open for more than 60 s”, risk FRA-004, HIGH, severity 9)
- The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its INC-03 execution (TX-0023) FAILED: the alarm activated at 142 s against a limit of 60 s. The other three incubators passed (TX-0021, TX-0022, TX-0024).
- The requirement has not been demonstrated on INC-03. The re-test is still outstanding: CC-26-019 (door switch replacement) is approved but not implemented, and it requires re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03. CAPA-26-012, which calls for that replacement and re-test, is still OPEN past its 2026-03-31 due date.
- OQ-INC-01 was approved with an exception under DEV-26-011, which was closed as a minor test incident on 2026-02-24. Closing the deviation does not replace the missing passing execution.

**Checked and treated as verified:** the other HIGH-risk URS items have passing executions, either directly or through a derived CS/FS spec that traces to them. Examples are URS-EBR-001 (via CS-EBR-01, TX-0080), URS-EMS-011/012 (via CS-EMS-02, TX-0068), URS-EMS-014 (via CS-EMS-03, TX-0070), and URS-LIMS-002/003/004 (via CS-LIMS-02, CS-LIMS-01, FS-LIMS-01; TX-0074/0075/0076). One caveat: TX-0070 for URS-EMS-014 predates CC-26-011 (paging provider change, implemented 2026-03-16). That change was assessed as needing no re-test, so I did not count it as unverified, but a reviewer may want to confirm that assessment.
